title: openbus envelope
description: The YAML frontmatter contract of every message on the openbus. A message is one Markdown file: this frontmatter plus a free-form body.

id.description: UUID identifying this message. Replies reference it via in_reply_to.

from.description: Agent name that wrote the message (no '@' prefix).

to.description: Recipient agent name, a comma-separated list, or '*' for broadcast.

thread.description: Thread id grouping a logical exchange, e.g. 'review:step-2-state'.

in_reply_to.description: id of the message being answered or acknowledged.

pr.description: PR number or URL the message refers to.

ttl_minutes.description: Request expiry in minutes; recipients should mark expired requests beyond this.

body.description: The message body (from the Markdown file below the frontmatter).
